strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with per-stage scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations (one initial + 7 stages), each preceded by local element-wise scale/unscale operations on the full tensor. Total 8 all-reduce dispatches. Trades simplicity and clarity for maximum synchronization overhead, but each all-reduce operates on the full W*S payload with minimal intermediate buffering.

strategies.name: Fused scale-allreduce with precomputed coefficients
strategies.desc: Precomputes the cumulative scaling factors for each shard across all 8 stages, then performs a single vectorized scale operation followed by one final all-reduce. Reduces to 1 all-reduce dispatch by trading 7 intermediate synchronization points for larger local computation and loss of incremental convergence semantics (may not match functional spec if stages are truly dependent).

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc: Decomposes each stage into reduce-scatter (each rank gets 1/W of result) followed by all-gather to reconstruct full vector, enabling parallelized per-shard scaling during the scattered phase. Uses 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG pairs), trading increased dispatch count for smaller per-rank payloads (S vs W*S) and better memory locality during scaling operations.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped scale and reduce
strategies.desc: Chunks the W*S tensor into smaller blocks and issues all-reduce on block i while computing scale/unscale for block i+1, attempting to hide computation latency behind communication. Still requires 8 all-reduce stages but with chunked payloads; total dispatches = 8 * num_chunks, trading granular overlap opportunity against dispatch overhead.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction with node-local fusion
strategies.desc:
Exploits multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions (within num_devices) followed by inter-node all-reduce, fusing multiple scale operations within node-local compute phases. Requires 16 collective dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels), trading vertical depth for reduced cross-node traffic and better cache reuse on node-local aggregations.
